name: handover
title: Integration handover record
for_each: select id,name from collections order by name

sections.title: Accountability
sections.sql: select name,owner,review_due from collections where id=$1

sections.title: Current checks
sections.sql: select name,method,url,expected_status,max_ms,lifecycle,health,last_status from request_health where collection_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due from actions where collection_id=$1 and state='open' order by due

name: review
title: Integration review record
for_each: select id,name from collections order by name

sections.title: Check evidence
sections.sql: select q.name,r.revision,r.status,r.elapsed_ms,r.passed,r.actor,r.created_at from runs r join requests q on q.id=r.request_id where q.collection_id=$1 order by r.created_at desc
